pages.text: $(bold)New Shadow Style: Simple Domain$(): a small world of its own, borrowing force to dispel force. $(br2)$(bold)Trigger$(): passively activates while wrapped inside another's Domain (the Cursed Core must have this skill installed). $(br2)$(bold)Effect$(): prop up a small barrier with Cursed Energy to ward off Domain effects — the paralysis of Unlimited Void, the slashes of Malevolent Shrine, and the like are all rendered void; the caster can move and can use items.

$(bold)Cost$(): the barrier monopolizes all of your Cursed Energy manipulation — $(red)you cannot use any technique while it lasts$(). $(br2)$(bold)Upkeep$(): it drains Cursed Energy continuously at 24 per second; when it runs dry the barrier shatters and Domain effects take hold as usual; leaving the Domain's range dispels it automatically. $(br2)$(bold)Use$(): a balanced skill for both action and defense — it holds off the Void's paralysis while letting you reposition freely, just don't expect to cast techniques.
